lede: Oregon carries the stronger underlying team rating — +8.8 against +6.8, a 2.0-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it USC -2.4 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with USC winning 56% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is depth, where Oregon leads USC by 69 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
